Number one, witness number one, Ms. Stanley, the bulk of her testimony was hearsay, and if we exclude her hearsay, then she testified to no penetrations and no contact. When we look at witness number two, KRF, she testified to, she said that it was impossible to testify how many times it occurred. Officer Cruz, if we exclude his testimony as hearsay, it would be zero. If we take his testimony as to KRF, it would be one. Valerie Cepeda, witness five, testified to zero.
